update_policy: Phone numbers, URLs, forms, intake hours, names, and emergency pathways are volatile. Responses should cite this pack or the contacts tool instead of memorizing contact details. Curators must bump version and last_updated after confirming current phone, email, and web-form details.
notes: Structured directory of NGOs, regulators, embassies, and hotlines for migrant-worker / trafficking complaints. Powers /api/contacts and /static/hotlines.html. Numbers verified at last_updated; /api/contacts also exposes last_verified_at per entry. Bumping a contact requires confirming current_phone_number AND current_web_form_url AND current_email. Embassy contacts especially can change with rotation. Curator workflow: edit this file, bump version + last_updated, run scripts/validate_curator_blocks.py. SAFETY: nothing in this file may auto-trigger an outbound email / phone call / form submission. The chat package's role is to surface contacts and pre-fill drafts the USER submits; it must never act on behalf of the user.

categories.embassy: Origin-country diplomatic mission in destination country
categories.ilo_office: Regional / country office of the International Labour Organization

entries.name: DMW Anti-Illegal Recruitment Branch (Philippines)
entries.address: DMW Building, Ortigas Avenue, Mandaluyong City, Philippines
entries.note: POEA was reorganized into the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) in 2023. Anti-Illegal Recruitment Branch retains the lead role. RA 8042 / RA 10022 violations also covered.

entries.name: OWWA 24/7 OFW Hotline (Philippines)
entries.address: OWWA Building, F.B. Harrison St., Pasay City, Philippines
entries.note: Open 24/7. Handles overseas worker emergencies including emergency repatriation. Free-of-charge service to OFWs and families.

entries.name: BP2MI / Aduan PMI (Indonesia)
entries.address: Jl. M.T. Haryono Kav. 52, Pancoran, Jakarta Selatan 12770, Indonesia
entries.note: Aduan PMI is the dedicated complaint portal for Indonesian Migrant Workers (Pekerja Migran Indonesia). BP2MI Reg. 9/2020 specifies the exclusive cost-component list — anything outside that list is reportable.

entries.name: Nepal Department of Foreign Employment (DoFE)
entries.address: Buddhanagar, Kathmandu, Nepal
entries.note: Nepal Foreign Employment Act 2007 §11(2) + 2015 Free-Visa-Free-Ticket Cabinet Decision are the controlling instruments. The 7-Gulf-country corridor is the largest by volume.

entries.name: Bangladesh Bureau of Manpower, Employment and Training (BMET)
entries.address: 89/2 Kakrail, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh
entries.note: BMET runs the BMET Smartcard system (mandatory pre-deployment ID). Wakala Group A/B/C licensing is the primary regulatory layer.

entries.name: Hong Kong Labour Department - Labour Relations Division
entries.address: Queensway Government Offices, 66 Queensway, Hong Kong
entries.note: Cap. 57 §32 (wage protection), Cap. 57A (10% commission cap), Cap. 163 (Money Lenders Ord., 60% APR cap), §17 (one rest day per week) are the main statutes.

entries.name: Singapore MOM Foreign Workforce Division (EFMA enforcement)
entries.address: 1500 Bendemeer Road, Singapore 339946
entries.note: EFMA Cap. 91A §22A: agency fee capped at 1 month's salary; employer bears agency cost for migrant domestic workers. SG MOM operates a 24h Foreign Worker Hotline.

entries.name: Saudi MoHR Musaned platform / 19911 unified labour hotline
entries.address: Ministry of Human Resources, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
entries.note: Saudi Kafala 2021 + 2024 reforms allow workers to change employers in defined circumstances. MoHR Domestic Worker Regulation Art. 6 (2013) requires written contract + monthly salary deposit. Musaned is the official online recruitment platform.

entries.name: UAE MoHRE / Tas'heel labour complaint
entries.address: MoHRE HQ, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
entries.note: Wage Protection System (WPS) is the mandatory monthly salary deposit. Decree 765/2015 mandates standard contract + 9 hours rest. Federal Law 10/2017 covers domestic workers.

entries.name: Kuwait Public Authority for Manpower (PAM) - Domestic Worker Department
entries.address: Ministries Complex, Kuwait City, Kuwait
entries.note: Kuwait Decree 19/2018 (Domestic Worker Protections) is the controlling instrument. Standard contract + monthly salary + 12 hours rest are mandated.

entries.name: Lebanon Internal Security Forces - Domestic Worker Hotline
entries.address: ISF HQ, Beirut, Lebanon
entries.note: Lebanon Cabinet Decree 13166/2021 introduced the Standard Unified Domestic Worker Contract. Kafala framework still applies de facto. Caritas Lebanon partners on shelter referrals.

entries.name: International Justice Mission (IJM) - Global intake
entries.address: PO Box 58147, Washington, DC 20037, USA
entries.note: Field offices in Cambodia, India, Philippines, Kenya, Uganda, Bolivia, Dominican Republic, Ghana, Romania. Local intake recommended over global intake for case-specific support.

entries.name: Polaris National Human Trafficking Hotline (US)
entries.address: PO Box 65323, Washington, DC 20035, USA
entries.note: 24/7. Free + confidential. SMS 'BeFree' to 233733. Operates the largest US-based trafficking case database.

entries.name: Mission for Migrant Workers Hong Kong (MfMW HK)
entries.address: Saint John's Cathedral, 4-8 Garden Road, Central, Hong Kong
entries.note: Walk-in shelter + legal aid + repatriation support for Filipina + Indonesian domestic workers. Strong PH-HK and ID-HK corridor focus.

entries.name: Indonesian Migrant Workers Union Hong Kong (IMWU HK)
entries.address: G/F, 31 Wing Lung Street, Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong
entries.note: Worker-led organization. Strongest case-coordination resource for Indonesian domestic workers in HK. Has helped recover wages in 100+ documented cases.

entries.name: ECPAT International (child sexual exploitation)
entries.address: 328/1 Phayathai Road, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
entries.note: Federation of 122+ member organizations across 104 countries. For immediate child-protection emergencies use the local hotline first; ECPAT for systemic / cross-border child-exploitation cases.

entries.name: Pravasi Nepali Coordination Committee (PNCC)
entries.address: Anamnagar-29, Kathmandu, Nepal
entries.note: Coalition of 60+ Nepali migrant-worker organizations. Strong advocacy on the NPR 10K cap + Free-Visa-Free-Ticket enforcement.

entries.name: NAPTIP - National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons (Nigeria)
entries.address: No. 9 Marsh Street, off Adetokunbo Ademola Crescent, Wuse II, Abuja, Nigeria
entries.note: TIPPEA Act 2015 is the controlling Nigerian instrument. Strong field-office network across all 36 states + FCT.

entries.name: ILO Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (Bangkok)
entries.address: 10/F UN Building, Rajdamnern Nok Avenue, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
entries.note: Not for individual case intake — use national NGOs / regulators. ILO Regional Office handles policy + technical assistance + ratification advocacy.

entries.name: IOM Counter-Trafficking 24/7 Hotline (Geneva)
entries.address: 17 route des Morillons, 1211 Geneva 19, Switzerland
entries.note: Operates field missions in 175+ countries. Use country-level mission for case intake; Geneva HQ for systemic policy issues.

entries.name: Philippine Consulate General Hong Kong (POLO + Assistance to Nationals)
entries.address: 14/F United Centre, 95 Queensway, Hong Kong
entries.note: POLO (Philippine Overseas Labor Office) handles labor cases. ATN (Assistance to Nationals) handles emergency repatriation + shelter. ANSO (Anti-Illegal Recruitment Branch) liaison for PH-side complaints.

entries.name: Indonesian Consulate General Hong Kong (Citizen Protection)
entries.address: 127-129 Leighton Road, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong
entries.note: Operates a worker shelter. Coordinates with IMWU HK for community case management.

entries.name: Philippine Embassy Riyadh - POLO + ATN
entries.address: Diplomatic Quarter, Riyadh 11693, Saudi Arabia
entries.note: Saudi corridor is the largest by Philippine OFW volume. ATN operates the Bahay Kalinga shelter.

entries.name: US State Department TIP Hotline / Embassy referral
entries.address: Office to Monitor and Combat Trafficking in Persons, US Department of State, Washington DC
entries.note: Not for individual case intake — use Polaris (1-888-373-7888). State Dept's J/TIP office produces the annual TIP Report (country tier rankings).

entries.name: ASEAN Convention Against Trafficking In Persons (ACTIP) - Focal Point Network
entries.address: 70A Jl. Sisingamangaraja, Jakarta 12110, Indonesia
entries.note: Coordinates the ACTIP Focal Point network. National Focal Points handle cross-border case referrals between ASEAN member states.

entries.name: INTERPOL Trafficking in Human Beings (THB) Subdirectorate (24/7 NCB Hotline)
entries.address: 200 quai Charles de Gaulle, 69006 Lyon, France
entries.note: Use the local NCB (National Central Bureau) for case-level reports. INTERPOL HQ coordinates between NCBs but does not investigate independently.
